subject.title: fix(browser): check own profile entries for profile operations

question: Should OpenClaw accept constructor and prototype as direct browser.profiles record keys while continuing to strip those names everywhere else in config merge patches?
rationale: The code matches the existing browser profile-name contract and has focused coverage, but it deliberately narrows a shared prototype-pollution guard and automation should not own that permanent security boundary choice.

options.title: Accept Scoped Direct Profile Keys
options.body: Allow only direct browser.profiles.constructor and browser.profiles.prototype records, keep nested blocked keys filtered, and proceed after exact-head CI.

options.title: Reserve Blocked Names
options.body: Reject constructor and prototype in browser profile validation/schema and keep the shared merge-patch filter strict for those names.

options.title: Pause For Encoded Keys
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want an encoded profile-key design so blocked object names never appear directly in config merge patches.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Direct Profile Keys
recommendation.body: Allow only direct browser.profiles.constructor and browser.profiles.prototype records, keep nested blocked keys filtered, and proceed after exact-head CI.
